name: Ogirihata Aoi
source:
An old friend of the protagonist who is one year younger than him.

She may be shy and timid, but in reality she is more stubborn and strong-minded than anyone else. Since childhood, she has dreamed of becoming a picture book author.

She is said to admire Aina and Hinowa, but she actually has more common sense than either of them.

──That is to say, she is a hard worker.

[translated from [url=http://wonder-fool.jp/ningyohime/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
